en.text: They took out the Pigeon Lady!
They took out the Chess player!
They took out the Test Pilot!
They took out the Rat King!
They took out that pathetic excuse for a vampire…
Oathkeeper is calling to me, Geist…
How long do you think you can hide from me, child…
Wesley… it's time we finish this…
Why you hiding, Shiv… don't wanna say hello to an old friend?
Come on, Sheriff… you didn't come all the way to New York just to hide from monsters…
Lash, come out and die like a man.
Is the big bad sandman trying to hide from me?
Where you run off to, Pocket…
Come out and play, Venator, don't be scared…
Bet you haven't been this scared in a long while, Vindicta...
Come on out and face me, Ivy, unless you want me to pay the Arroyos a visit…
Seven… don't tell me you're scared, I expected so much more from you.
Infernus… you didn’t think you could try to burn me and I'd just let you go, did you?
You got some fight in ya…
I got my eye on you…
You don't think you're gonna win do you…
I won't stop until they're dead…
Love what you do, you never work a day in your life…
I could listen to that scream all day.
This is the best vacation I ever took.
God I love visiting New York.
Don't worry about The Troubadour, Sheriff, worry about me….
I should have given The Troubadour some professional courtesy.
Came a long way just to die here, Sheriff…
You know, I liked her so much I might pay Macomb a visit later…
He was big boy, now wasn't he?
It's fun when they're strong like that…
Oh he put up a good fight…
I like you, Detective, you're fun to play with.
Machines are so less satisfying to kill.
I heard about Miss Shelly, Bebop, and I can't wait to meet her.
THe soft hearted are usually the first to die…
You're not the hero, Paige, you're the victim.
She put up more of a fight than most.
All she managed to do was prolong her sufferin'….
She thought she was on top, didn't she?
I love it when they think they're clever.
Paradox, you can do better than that.
I can't wait to find more of her little friends.
Cute tricks aren't gonna be enough to stop me, Doorman.
Why don't you scurry back to The Baroness, doorman…
The streets aren't your dominion Doorman, they're mine.
Stay out of my business, Doorman.
Now what was his wife's name again? Marla?
Don't worry, Dynamo, your wife'll be joining you soon enough.
You're gonna regret angering me, Professor.
He's taking a long nap now…
I'm not worried about a kid with a pillow.
You're gonna' learn your place on the food chain, Apollo.
You may be better than a human, but you're not better than me.
Daddy is going to be so disappointed.
You weren't smart enough to run, McGinnis…
Machines were never gonna save you, McGinnis.
I'll break all her fancy little toys…
Daddy Fairfax ain't gonna be happy he lost his favorite toy, is he?
It's no fun when you're just putting someone out of their misery…
He'll sew himself up and be back…
Come back any time, Victor, I'll be ready…
I can't have you putting someone as fun as Oathkeeper under lock and key, Geist.
It's over, Geist. Set Oathkeeper free.
I can't believe someone like her trapped Oathkeeper…
And here I was hoping to find an equal…
Seven died a lot easier than I expected.
That boy still has too much humanity left in him…
You still gotta lot to learn, Seven…
I was expecting so much more from you, Seven.
I enjoyed playing with that one…
Yeah, the OSIC are really in control…
You'd think the OSIC would have sent their best
Been a while since someone made me work for it like that…
Lady, you need a couple hundred years before you're close to my level.
Their sniper isn't a problem anymore.
The lion was turned into a house cat…
No one's gonna miss a dead bartender.
Can't have you settin' me on fire, now can I?
All he could do was delay the inevitable…
Kelvin, all you managed to do was prolong your suffering.
Thought he could burrow away from me…
I love it when they're brave and stupid.
I've killed hundreds of men like you, Lash.
What do I have to fear from a man like him…
Throw your life away, Lash, makes no difference to me…
Not as much fun when they're already dead.
Noble men bleed just like any other…
Thought the Djinn would be more of a threat…
Whatever Nashala is paying him, it's too much…
Always nice when I get to kill Wesley's friends.
Huntin' man ain't the same as hunting me…
Wesley could never stop me, and you're no Wesley.
What's the matter, Graves? I thought you liked playing with the dead.
You're just a kid with borrowed power, Graves.
Only way this was going to end, Wesley.
Been a long time coming, Grey Talon.
The fun had to end sometime, didn’t it?
You had a good run, Talon.
I waited a long time to kill you, Wesley.
When's the Vatican gonna give up?
I expected more from the Sword of Saint Benedict.
How many of your order do I gotta kill before you realize you can't stop me…
God ain't coming to save you, Venator.
Bet the anger's gonna taint the meat…
Being a victim is different than playing one, ain't it, Billy?
Does that guy ever stop complainin'...
I hate it when they whine…
If you hadn't put yourself in a muzzle maybe I'd be worried.
The Baxter Society made you soft.
You're not the man I thought you were, Shiv.
There are worst things out there than your father, Pocket…
The chase had to end eventually…
It ain't your family that you should be worrying about, Pocket.
You didn’t think you were actually gonna win, did you, Pocket?
You never had a chance, Ivy.
Optimism was only gonna get you so far…
You've never fought someone like me, Ivy.
I enjoyed being part of the act, Celeste.
You're out of your depth, child.
Kid like you is never gonna be Viscount.
The Vampire Nation is a Ponzi scheme, Mina, the sooner you realize that the better…
I almost feel bad killing someone so pathetic.
No one is going to miss her.
I'm not quite sure what I killed…
I'll never pretend to understand The Deep.
Flesh isn't supposed to have that texture.
All your life was leading up to this moment of failure.
You trained a long time just to die here, boy.
You were never going to be a hero, Warden… you were always destined to be a martyr.
Shame you threw your whole life away.
Warden never had a chance against me.
Werewolves always think they're so tough…
She wasn't as dangerous as she thought she was…
Silver, if Grey Talon couldn't stop me what chance do you have?
Oh look, the town drunk wanted to pretend she was a hero.
Wraith is too worried about money and not enough about winning.
You're not as good as you think you are, Wraith.
She can try to get away but it ain't gonna work.
I ain't scared of someone like you, Yamato….
Might be time to pull back…
You're looking for The Troubadour, right?
Yeah, you don't wanna find him.
Macomb matters a lot to you, but to him it was just a fun time that will get lost in the ocean of memory. But if you find him… if he knows he got his hooks in you? You're going to be his hobby.
Oh I wouldn't want to spoil the surprise, but trust me Sheriff… for your sake. Let it go.
Tie them down Holliday, and leave the rest to me.
You want 'em dead? Tie 'em down for me.
You spell holliday with one l or two?
I know who's gun that is. You gonna be able to make him proud?
You afraid of things getting messy, Detective?
You're just gonna have to wait and find out, now aren't you…
Been travelin' a long way to get here…haven't had time to rest up and get a proper meal.
Thanks for giving me something to look forward to Bebop
Well aren't you a thoughtful scrap golem
Counting the days until I'm gone?
How 'bout you tell me a story, Paige.
I don't take kindly to threats.
You're fun. I'll let it slide.
I ate before I showed up to the ritual.
That's what I love about humanity.
Sure, let's call it kindness and not you compromising your morals because you wanna win.
What size jacket do you wear?
You got any friends you don't mind go missing?
You don't seem to be nervous about working with me.
I've found that to be a rarity.
Do your job or I'm going to tear through your little hotel.
You strike me as a man who loves what he does for a living.
Oh I definitely derive enjoyment from what I do.
See you got yourself a wedding ring, Professor.
No professor, fail today and she'll die for you.
Don't worry about me not capitalizing professor… there's few things I like more than helpless victim.
Mighty kind of you offering up your students like that, I appreciate it.
Significantly less entertaining, but still appreciated.
It's a shame we're on the same side, I would love to find out what a smart lady like you tastes like.
Just to be clear, I'm talking about drinking your blood, nothing untoward.
I just didn’t want there to be any confusion.
Ready to get your hands dirty?
I was expecting a little more enthusiasm
Where do you work again? Fairfax and Sons?
If I did it certainly didn't leave an impression on me.
I'm gonna be honest, it all kind of blends together.
You know, you're puttin' too high a premium on your past.
No you don't. You need to know where you are. The past is a trap, the future is a fantasy. Just be, Victor, you'll be happier.
I was talking to your arm.
Oh we go back a long ways…
<laughs> Oh today is gonna be fun…
That ward's lookin' like it ain't lasting much longer Geist.
You gotta be scared as hell…
You know, I used to be like you.
I used to play the game, wear the lace, say the pretty words. Let me tell you, friend... the pursuit of power is a trap.
Seven, people paint you as a monster, but underneath all the falderal, you're no boogie man, you're just a man.
I'm looking forward to seeing if you live up to the hype.
Think you can keep up, Haze?
All business. That's fine. I can appreciate directness. I am going to kill more than you, though.
Smile Haze, you're gonna like killing people with me.
Life's more fun when you accept who you are Haze…
Why limit yourself to the friends of humanity, there's plenty of people that deserve to die.
Now that’s some ambition I can appreciate.
What's with the rifle, don't like working up close?
I thought I was gonna like you…
Just to get this out of the way, I'm not precious about murder. If I'm carving someone up and you wanna take the shot I'm not gonna be offended.
You got a gleam in your eye Infernus… how long has it been since you really cut loose.
While I do have a song in my heart, I am not.
You friends with every bartender in Manhattan?
No. Never met the man, just know him by reputation.
Let's just say I'm glad you're on my side.
Now that is the question, isn't it…
You're lookin a little upset Kelvin.
Careful now, you keep talkin' like that you might hurt my feelings; and no one wants that…
I know it's not necessary, I just like to go above and beyond expectations.
It's nice to work with some fellow predators.
I mean one of you holds down a victim while the other beats them to death. Seems pretty damn predatory to me.
So how often do you drag people down into the sewers and rip their arms off?
You boys need to live a little.
Worried I've developed a taste for mole?
Don't worry boys, I got plenty of people to kill this trip without worrying about you.
Are you that arrogant stevedore everyone's been talking about.
Heard you like hurting people, Lash.
So how much dirty work do the Djinn have you do?
I see. So she doesn't trust you.
If you don't like it now, wait till you hear the sounds I make when I'm ripping out your gullet.
Ritual's startin' pretty boy. We'll finish this later.
If she really did she would have told you to play nice.
What happens if I break that fancy bottle of yours.
I see the Baxter society is sending their B team to help me.
How could I forget, you're a scary killer now.
Stop pretending like you're gonna do a damn thing about my tone.
Which I'd say is a testament to how satisfying it is.
It's a remarkably ugly cat, I can't help it.
Wesley, if I was gonna murder your grandkids we both know I woulda tied you down and made you watch.
Oh you're certainly gonna try. But it ain't gonna be today. You need me.
The Patrons have a curious sense of humor now don't they.
The silent treatment? Really? Don't tell me you're still raw about Oklahoma
What are the boys and girls at the Baxter Society gonna say about us working together.
You ain't the first Venator to make that claim, and you sure as hell ain't gonna be the last.
That's where you're wrong Father. I've killed hundreds of men who think they're the exception to the rule… and let me tell you: the exceptional and the pathetic bleed out just the same.
Forgive me father, for I will sin.
What would your Vatican masters say if they saw you now….
I'm gonna enjoy taking my time with you when this is over.
You worried your new friends are gonna get mad?
Enjoy your indignation. In about 10 seconds everyone is gonna see who you really are.
What the hell happened to you Shiv… you used to be a man.
No hug for an old friend?
That's the Shiv I like to see. Glad to know he's still in there.
I think you'll get a taste for it.
I bet you're gonna surprise yourself.
I can smell blood on your jacket, whose is it?
I'm guessing you didn't cut yourself shaving.
Well lookie here, "The Savior of Spanish Harlem" herself.
Legends don't get to choose what they're called.
Yes you are. You know it and you're afraid of it. Don't be.
I don't care what your name is, you'll be dead long before your relevant in my world.
Look at us, the sower and the reaper.
You save lives and I take them.
Well that's mighty kind of you miss.
Ya know who I am, right?
Then why aren’t you being a good little vampire and following Simon's orders?
I got a funny story about that… I'll tell you later.
I dunno, it's not the same if I don't work for it.
Why do you care so much.
Miss, you've made a compelling argument.
I don't know if the rest of our team shares your exuberance.
What, you lookin' to get drinks?
I do suppose I tell people that a lot.
Then keep me far away from the cube.
You must really hate the Patrons if you're willing to work with a guy like me.
You like to gamble, right Wraith?
Oh it's gonna be a massacre.
You should be Wraith, otherwise I-
Not particularly, I sleep like a baby.
That's because I murdered someone before I showed up for the ritual.
a musician's gotta warm up before they perform.
You're not going to whine about morality are you?
Stick with me kid, I teach you all sorts of things.
I would say vagabond, but there is no need to quibble over definition.
You know how to use that sword boy?
Try it, and your rich daddy will be paying for an expensive funeral.
You're a house cat pretending to be a lion.
I see she's a woman of taste.
So you're the girl that spends her time playing with monsters, huh?
Looking at pretty headstones ain't the same thing as watching me rip out someone's throat.
We're about to find out, aren't we
I'm looking for blood not your charity.
That's one way to put it.
Hey Billy, are you a human with a goat head, or a goat with a human body?
Ya know, I got a soft spot for carnie folk.
Yeah. There's something refreshing about humans being unapologetic for what they are. Normally there's just so much….
I was gonna say artifice but you cut right to the heart of it.
No, I'm planning on killing you after the ritual because I know what unicorn blood tastes like.
It's a lot less fun for me.
Silver Silver Silver… how's my favorite cut rate bounty hunter.
I'm lucky? Sweetheart, any other day your heart would be out of your body by now.
The satisfaction of a job well done.
I know I'm not Shiv, but I hope you enjoy our time together.
I don't know what's going to be better… when I save your life and you owe me: or when you realize you have to save mine in order to win.
I like to think of myself as one of kind.
Ya know I've never been to Japan.
I never had much use for a name. Names are for people who want to be remembered. Me? My existence is like gravity or time… a concept that you fear but cannot escape. I simply Am.
The Troubadour ain't got nothin' on me.
Oh, I'm exactly who you think I am.
By the time I'm through with them, the cops won't be able to identify the body.
Fact of the matter is I'd do this for free; the Patron's gift is just a bonus.
The Elders of New Amsterdam are soft… clinging to archaic titles like they grant them real power.
Can't wait to see how Manhattan's changed in a generation…
Let's get this show on the road, I'm feeling peckish.
We all got weaknesses, but mercy ain't one of mine.
They're gonna cry. They're gonna beg. They're gonna scream.
I don't need the Patron's help…
I have my own plans tonight…
Do I look like I need to be the Patron's errand boy?
Wish I could help, but I have an old friend I need to say hello to.
I came to New York for a reason, and it wasn't to help the Patrons.
I don't work for anybody but myself.
Today I plan to sit back and just watch the carnage unfold.
They're gonna tear each other apart for whatever scraps the Patrons give 'em, and it's gonna be beautiful to watch.
I don't need the Patrons. The Patrons need me.
Killin's no fun if someone's telling you to do it, you gotta just feel it in the moment. Like Jazz.
I can't wait to rip their lungs out.
I love working with my hands…
Ready to get up close and personal…
The best part of working close is you get to hear every beautiful sound.
My hands are twitching in anticipation…
I'm gonna tear them apart and there ain't a damn thing they can do about it.
Ready to do what I do best.
I'll be behind them in no time…
I'll get the element of surprise….
They'll think they're safe, then I'll be right behind 'em.
Once they're marked there's nothing they can do.
I won't be deterred from my purpose.
I'll take whatever I want whenever I want.
Once I set my eyes on someone, there's no shaking me.
I can't wait to meet the lovely people of New York.
There's no one I can't track.
Let them try to run, it won't help.
I love it when they cower.
If I find someone on their own, god himself couldn't save 'em.
I'll find them wherever they run to.
I love the thrill of the hunt.
The hunters will be on the prowl tonight…
They're gonna be lost in the wilderness…
The darkness will come for them.
First comes the darkness, then comes the terror.
They're gonna hear me whistle, then they're gonna die.
I bring the night with me.
They won't know where to turn.
The walls are gonna close in on them….
They're gonna feel alone and they're gonna feel scared.
You gotta let the dread marinate a little.
Let's see what your insides look like.
No time to play with my food.
They can try to fight back, it won't matter.
Relevant character names from the game Deadlock.
Let's take out the Pigeon Lady.
Let's take out the Test Pilot.
Let's take out the Rat King.
Grey Talon, I can heal you!
Check out what The Doorman bought.
I'm not ready for a team fight.
Check out what Grey Talon bought.
Not a bad way to spend the afternoon…
Any of you fine folk wanna kill again, let me know…
I hope to see y'all again real soon…
Friendly word of advice, you might want to stay away from Times Square tonight… I plan on celebrating.
Every single one of them are gonna die…
Take a good look at 'em now.. They won't be recognizable later.
Now I just gotta pick which one of these fine people I'm gonna carve up first…
Y'all came a long way to die, friends…
I see that sorry excuse for a vampire.
Ready to make 'em afraid of the dark…
They're not going to see us coming.
